scripts.migrate:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env development
scripts.migrate:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env development
scripts.migrate:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env production
scripts.migrate:status:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env development
scripts.migrate:status:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env test
scripts.migrate:status:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env production
scripts.seed:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env development
scripts.seed:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env test
scripts.seed:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env production
scripts.fresh:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && npm run migrate:dev && npm run seed:dev
scripts.fresh:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && npm run migrate:test && npm run seed:test
scripts.fresh:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && npm run migrate:prod
